primary_layer_aggregation: equal mean over all 18 KDA layers, 16 heads, and value dimensions
time_alignment: post-update post-QDQ state E_t with FP q_t; output KL at token t is pre-current-QDQ and reflects persistent QDQ through t-1

metric_definitions.B0: post-QDQ state MSE at the window start
metric_definitions.P1: mean squared true K3 readout E_t @ normalized(q_FP,t)/sqrt(128) at the window start
metric_definitions.P2_W128: E_t contracted with the second moment of normalized FP queries from [t-128,t)
metric_definitions.P3_H32: mean P1-form readout energy over 32-token persistent-QDQ branch rollout
metric_definitions.P3_H128: mean P1-form readout energy over 128-token persistent-QDQ branch rollout
metric_definitions.B1_H32: mean post-QDQ state MSE over 32-token rollout
metric_definitions.B1_H128: mean post-QDQ state MSE over 128-token rollout
metric_definitions.B2_H32: mean teacher-forced KL(FP logits || branch logits) over 32 tokens
metric_definitions.B2_H128: mean teacher-forced KL(FP logits || branch logits) over 128 tokens

acceptance_rules.stable_natural_ranking: positive Spearman rho in all four document-anchor panels
acceptance_rules.incremental_over_baseline: candidate exceeds each named cheaper baseline in both rho and pairwise concordance in at least three of four panels, and positive residual rank association after JPROP in at least three panels
acceptance_rules.cheaper_proxy_preferred: P2 matches or exceeds P3 in rho and concordance in at least three of four panels and is materially cheaper
